syllabusNote: Chapter lists follow the NCERT rationalised syllabus (2023–24). Check against the edition your school uses — schools sometimes still teach from older printings.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.tagline: Numbers, shapes, and the reasoning underneath them
subjects.description: Twelve chapters that walk from number systems and polynomials through triangles, circles and statistics. Each lesson pairs a plain-language explanation with worked examples and a short practice set.

subjects.name: Science
subjects.tagline: From particles of matter to the sound you hear
subjects.description: Matter, atoms and cells in the first half; motion, force, gravitation, work, sound and food resources in the second. Experiments are described with everyday materials you already have at home.

subjects.name: Social Science
subjects.tagline: Four books: history, geography, civics, economics
subjects.description: Revolutions in Europe, the making of modern India's physical landscape, how democracy actually runs, and why a village economy matters. Twenty chapters across four NCERT books.

books.name: India and the Contemporary World — I (History)
chapters: Socialism in Europe and the Russian Revolution
Nazism and the Rise of Hitler

subjects.name: English
subjects.description: Prose, poetry and supplementary reading from the two Class 9 books, with vocabulary, comprehension questions and writing practice for each piece.

books.name: Beehive — Poetry
chapters: A Slumber Did My Spirit Seal

books.name: Moments — Supplementary Reader
chapters: A House Is Not a Home

subjects.name: Hindi
subjects.tagline: कक्षा 9 हिंदी — काव्य, गद्य और पूरक पाठ्यपुस्तक
subjects.description: Course A (क्षितिज-1 and कृतिका-1) and Course B (स्पर्श and संचयन). Poetry, prose and supplementary reading, with word meanings and question practice in Hindi and English.
subjects.note: Chapter titles for Hindi ship with the Hindi content pack in Session 1. The book list above is fixed by NCERT for Class 9.
